status_definitions.absent: The capability is not shipped in Perry.
status_definitions.wired: The capability is connected in the product, but this registry has no focused unit evidence.
status_definitions.unit-tested: A focused repository test covers the capability; any recorded live evidence is incomplete or does not yet meet the live-tested gate.
status_definitions.live-tested: A passing parsed structured actual-run artifact binds the capability to its feature, build, environment, and result; release proof is still absent.
status_definitions.release-proven: Passing parsed structured live and release actual-run artifacts bind the capability to the verified build and environment, with a distinct release binary or bundle digest and identity.

features.name: Global hotkey, user-recordable with modifier choice
features.support: Local macOS app
limitations: The binding is present, but this registry has no app-target live test for global registration.

features.name: Wake word
features.support: Optional on-device wake word
limitations: Wake word is off by default, onboarding requires an explicit choice, and the menu bar shows when ambient listening is enabled. This registry still has no microphone or long-running live-session test.
The registry does not record a last successful run for this capability.

features.name: Realtime duplex voice
features.support: Optional realtime microphone streaming, response audio, interruption, and bounded per-utterance queues
limitations: Synthetic tests cover bounded backpressure, saturated commit ordering, stale generations, fallback dispatch races, response tombstones, safe endpoints, first-audio timing, acoustic barge-in analysis, and the owned-worker endurance gate. The 30-minute live duplex run, device-route matrix, echo-cancellation behavior, and measured latency budgets remain unproven.
The registry does not record a last successful run for this capability.

The 2026-08-27 and 2026-08-28 Markdown audits remain contextual evidence only; neither contains a parsed structured actual-run artifact, so this capability remains unit-tested.

features.name: Spatial Ask: point at the screen and get grounded answers
features.support: Default session mode; bounded references, follow-ups, stale-answer refusal

Live end-to-end Ask against a real provider requires a BYOK key plus Screen Recording permission; this registry has no structured live run.

features.name: Ghost rehearsal: plan preview with numbered marks before execution
features.support: Plan card previews typed steps on real targets with Run / Step through / Replay / Edit / Stop
limitations: Marks require grounded selectors; actions without a resolvable target show no mark, and Replay repaints from a fresh observation.
This registry has no structured live run of the rehearsal card on the real screen.

features.name: Durable write-ahead receipts for workspace execution
features.support: Foreground and background workspace transforms journal through TaskCoordinator before dispatch
limitations: Receipts cover workspace file transforms; GUI operations are verified at execution but do not produce filesystem receipts.
Crash-recovery coverage is simulated in tests (relaunch fixtures), not a measured live crash drill.

features.name: Agent Undo: conflict-safe reversal of verified workspace changes
features.support: Typed inverse actions, approved and journaled like forward work; stops at the first conflict
limitations: Covers workspace file transforms only (create, rename, trash, restore). GUI actions and integration writes are reported with no Undo.
Removing a task record removes its receipts and ends reversibility for that task.

features.name: Shared control: take over, steer, and continue mid-task
features.support: User takeover pauses Perry at a step boundary; steering and continue replan from fresh screen state
limitations: Steering settles at the current step boundary - it cannot interrupt an action already dispatched.
Continuation replans forward only; previously completed steps are never re-executed, and this registry has no structured live run.

features.name: Watch & Learn: bounded demonstration recording with review before save
features.support: User-bounded recording drafts a step list for review; secure-field values are never captured
limitations: Clicks outside every observed element are dropped, and secure-field keystrokes record nothing - a routine can silently lack a step the user intended.
Recording requires Accessibility permission; this registry has no structured live capture.

features.name: Routine replay against fresh observation with parameters
features.support: Saved routines rebuild typed plans from the live screen; parameters prompt per run; manual steps pause
limitations: Renamed apps or moved targets pause the run for input rather than clicking blind.
Replays run through the same approval and verification path as fresh tasks; this registry has no structured live run.

features.name: Optional notch status pill
features.support: Glanceable status at the top-center safe area, off by default; menu bar remains the primary status surface
limitations: Only renders on displays with a notch-safe area; other configurations keep the menu-bar strip.
Status only - approvals, text entry, and Ask/Guide/Do stay on the spatial surface; this registry has no structured live run across display configurations.

features.name: History shows provider route, verification, and Undo availability
features.support: Per-session rows record the runtime that answered, the verified outcome, and whether a safe Undo still exists
limitations: Undo availability reflects retained task records; records pruned or erased end the badge.
Provider route is recorded for provider-backed runs only; local-planner runs show the local route.

features.name: Onboarding demo answers about the screen before guiding or doing
features.support: The guided demo proves spatial Ask first, then Guide, then a small verified Do task
limitations: The demo requires Screen Recording and Accessibility grants; without them it reports honestly instead of faking steps.
This registry has no structured live run of the full onboarding flow.

features.name: No telemetry: zero outbound network while opted out
features.support: Thirty-minute network capture of a real Perry.app fixture with telemetry preference off
limitations: The capture covers the fixture app at revision 4b768c95 on macOS 26.5.1; a different build or enabled provider flows (BYOK Ask/Do, realtime voice) legitimately use the network and are outside this capture's scope.
Empty lsof/perry.log artifacts mean no socket or log anomalies were recorded during the window; the claim is bounded to the captured 1800 samples.
